The fixed-centre cheat

Flip to the cheat and galaxies fly from one origin in a fixed space. At the centre it looks innocent. Re-anchor off-centre and it breaks in your hands — a galaxy turns around to approach you, v stops tracking d, the rose pegs. If you can find the centre, you're in a cheat.

nudge the demo defaults to an OFF-CENTRE seat so the break is found.
